title: Neon Ronin Cyberpunk Overpass Tough Phone Case | Cyberpunk Streetwear Dual-Layer Cover
description:
Protect your phone in premium artisan style with the Neon Ronin Cyberpunk Overpass Tough Phone Case.

Designed for the Cyberpunk Streetwear collection, this case combines high-impact shock absorption with edge-to-edge full-bleed artwork that will not fade, scratch, or peel.

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS:
- Dual-layer protection: Impact-resistant Polycarbonate outer shell + Shock-absorbing TPU silicone liner
- Full-bleed 300 DPI sublimation printing with rich saturated pigments
- Engineered camera bezel with 35% upper safe zone protection
- Wireless charging (Qi & MagSafe compatible)
- Available for Apple iPhone & Samsung Galaxy flagship models

CARE INSTRUCTIONS:
Wipe clean with a damp microfiber cloth. Mild soap may be used if needed.
prompt: Full-bleed 9:16 vertical phone case artwork. Cyberpunk ronin warrior with glowing neon oni visor and futuristic techwear in lower 65% composition. Upper 35% safe zone shows towering rainy megacity skyline with glowing kanji holograms. Electric cyan and vibrant magenta highlights. High-contrast vector styling, edge-to-edge pure illustration.
